OFFICERS
Section 4.1 Officers.
The officers of the Corporation shall consist of a President, a Secretary, and a Treasurer, and may include a Chair of the Board and any assistant officers as appointed by the Board.
Section 4.2 Appointment.
Officers shall be appointed by the Board annually and shall serve at the pleasure of the Board.
Section 4.3 Duties.
(a) President. Chief executive officer of the Corporation, responsible for oversight of operations.
 (b) Secretary. Maintains corporate records and minutes.
 (c) Treasurer. Responsible for financial management and reporting.
Section 4.4 Removal.
Any officer may be removed by the Board at any time.
Section 4.5 Vacancies.
A vacancy in any office shall be filled by the Board.
